top_findings.title: team_statistics inflates season records (double-counts UTC-shifted duplicate fixtures)
top_findings.evidence: src/query.rs:163 team_statistics builds a MatchFilter with competition/season = None unless passed, then calls filtered_matches (src/query.rs:783), which deduplicates via match_signature (src/query.rs:932). match_signature keys on item.date verbatim, so the same 2019 Série A fixture recorded in Brasileirao_Matches.csv and in BR-Football-Dataset.csv with a ±1-day UTC-shifted date produces two distinct signatures and is NOT collapsed. _factual.json: expected 28W-6D-4L (38 played, 90 pts), got inflated row figures; factual_accuracy=0.5 in scores.json.
top_findings.suggestion: Route team_statistics through authoritative_competition_matches (single-source-per-competition, as R9 standings already do), and/or make match_signature tolerant of a ±1-day date difference. This is a factual-accuracy defect, not an absent capability — the R6 tool exists and returns aggregated W/L/D + goals.

requirement_coverage_note: Pinned REQUIREMENTS.json: 12/12 implemented. Second opinion: R6 is implemented (team_statistics src/query.rs:163); the first eval's 0.8 conflated the separate factual_accuracy=0.5 gate with requirement coverage.
